title: Polynomial-time closure of the paired verifier
statement: Let $C,c\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $V$ be a language of finite bit strings. If $V$ is decidable in polynomial time, then the paired verifier language defined by $C,c,$ and $V$ is also decidable in polynomial time.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is a language of finite bit strings
replaced:
Let $C, c \in \mathbb{N}$ and let $V \subseteq \{0,1\}^{*}$ be a language in
$\mathsf{P}$. Then the language of binary strings $y$ that are well-formed
self-delimiting pair encodings $y = \langle x, u\rangle$ ($x$ with every bit
doubled, then the separator $01$, then $u$ verbatim) with $|u| = C(|x|+1)^c$ and
$xu \in V$ also belongs to $\mathsf{P}$.
